3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Midnight. I was in the living room watching the tail end of a news report when I heard the phone ring.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I sighed and walked over to the phone, wondering who could be calling me this late.

8.speaker: Player
8.text: “Don't you know what time it is?”

11.speaker: Player
11.text: “If you wanted to talk to Monica, she's sleeping right now.”

16.speaker: Player
16.text: “Spit it out, woman. What's going on?”

18.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
18.text: “I don't think it can. I didn't know who to call.”

19.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
19.text: “The thing is, I was supposed to meet with Petr today to hand him the signed divorce papers.”

20.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
20.text: “But he didn't come to our designated meeting point. I figured he might have been too drunk to remember, so I went to the apartment he's been renting -- but he wasn't there either."

21.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
21.text: “I asked around. The landlord, the neighbors, his friends...”

23.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
23.text: “Trust me, Anton, I couldn't be more excited to be rid of this man. But I can't close off this chapter of my life without his cooperation."

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: As I put down the phone, Monica sleepily approached with a glass of water in her hand.

30.speaker: Monica
30.text: “Who was that? Is everything all right?”

31.speaker: Player
31.text: “Yes, just a work call. Sorry for waking you up.”

33.speaker: Player
33.text: “It was Evelyn. She said Petr went missing.”

35.speaker: Monica
35.text: “I'm surprised she still cares about him.”

36.speaker: Player
36.text: “She's a middle-aged woman. What kind of a life will she have without a husband?”

37.speaker: Player
37.text: “She was a good influence on him.”

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: She looked at me in confusion and anger.

46.speaker: Player_Italic
46.text: Call Karl to ask him about Petr.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: I went to bed after a few hours.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: The phone rang for only a few seconds.

55.speaker: Karl Greiser
55.text: “Not a problem, sir. I only sleep for three fifteen-minute intervals per night.”

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: I heard the faint rustling of a notepad being opened.

61.speaker: Karl Greiser
61.text: “As you command. I will report my findings shortly.”

63.speaker: Player
63.text: "Thank you for your help. As always."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: He hung up. I put away the phone and went down to the bedroom to get some sleep.

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: I heard a soft voice from the other end.

68.speaker: Player
68.text: “He's probably just with some other girl."

70.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
70.text: "I don't know, Anton. He was in bad shape after your press conference."

71.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
71.text: "You forced him to resign rather than admit you couldn't tell your own secretary was a spy. It kind of is your problem, Anton."

72.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
72.text: "Can't you get your police contacts to look into this? Just to be on the safe side?"

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "All right. If it'll give you peace of mind, I will."

74.speaker: Player
74.text: "You're being paranoid, Evelyn. Let's just wait a few more days and see if he turns up."

77.speaker: Player
77.text: "I knew, by the way. About all his affairs. I'm so sorry I never came to you about it."

78.speaker: Player
78.text: "I never had any idea he was cheating on you before this, by the way. You know I would've come to you about it."

79.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
79.text: "Boys will be boys. Isn't that what they say?"

85.speaker: Monica
85.text: "I don't sleep much these days anyway."

94.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
94.text: "It's been weeks since he and that woman ran away, hasn't it?"

95.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
95.text: "I was told I couldn't finalize the divorce until he signs the papers. So I went to the apartment he's been renting."

96.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
96.text: "He wasn't there. Actually, it looked like nobody had been living there for weeks. I called the housekeeper at his villa in Erlory, and she told me the same thing."

97.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
97.text: "He's not some sort of escape artist. He's instantly recognizable. And you said you had your best men on the case."

98.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
98.text: "Be honest, Anton. What really happened to him?"

99.speaker: Player
99.text: "I-- I don't know. I'll have this looked into at once."

101.speaker: Player
101.text: "Everything I know, I already said at my press conference."

103.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
103.text: "Then maybe something else is going on that neither of us know about."

105.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
105.text: "Honestly, I couldn't be more excited to be rid of the man. But I'll never get closure if I can't track him down."

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "Forget closure! Hit the town! Live a little!"

108.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
108.text: "That's not how this works, and you know it."

109.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
109.text: "I have a few journalist contacts left over from my Holsord Post days. I'm thinking of asking them to investigate this."

110.speaker: Player
110.text: "No need to get them involved. I'll do it myself."

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "That's a great idea. Let me know if they come up with any leads."

112.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
112.text: "All right. Let me know what you can find."

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "It was Evelyn. She's got some crackpot theories about what happened to Petr."

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: I went to my private study, picked up the phone and called Karl.

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: The phone rang for only a few seconds.

127.speaker: Karl Greiser
127.text: “Not a problem, sir. I only sleep for three fifteen-minute intervals per night.”

128.speaker: Karl Greiser
128.text: "As we discussed, Mr. Vectern has been well and properly disposed of."

130.speaker: Player
130.text: "I told Evelyn not to investigate this, but I don't know how much longer I can hold her off."

131.speaker: Karl Greiser
131.text: "Would you like her to be disposed of as well, sir?"

134.speaker: Karl Greiser
134.text: "Frankly, sir, I would advise against it. It would only lead to more unnecessary suspicions."

136.speaker: Karl Greiser
136.text: "We still have Mr. Vectern's wedding ring and a sample of his handwriting. It would be fairly easy to plant evidence of his death by suicide."

138.speaker: Player
138.text: "What are you waiting for? Get on it!"

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: As I was eating breakfast the next morning, the phone rang.

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: I picked up. It was Karl.

152.speaker: Karl Greiser
152.text: "I've done what we agreed on, sir."

156.speaker: Karl Greiser
156.text: "I have some unfortunate news regarding Mr. Vectern."

158.speaker: Karl Greiser
158.text: "His wedding ring, a half-empty bottle of pills, and a handwritten note were found on a bridge overlooking the Unger River."

159.speaker: Karl Greiser
159.text: "We surmise that he took his own life."

160.speaker: Karl Greiser
160.text: "His wedding ring, a half-empty bottle of pills, and a handwritten note were planted on a bridge overlooking the Unger River."

162.speaker: Player
162.text: "Do you think Evelyn will be convinced?"

164.speaker: Karl Greiser
164.text: "The man was obviously in an unstable state before. I don't think it's a stretch of the imagination."

165.speaker: Karl Greiser
165.text: "We kept it vague. Asking forgiveness from you and Evelyn, that sort of thing."

167.speaker: Player
167.text: "Can you call Evelyn and tell her? I'm not sure I'm up to the task."

168.speaker: Player
168.text: "I'll tell Evelyn the news. Thanks again for your help and discretion."

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: Karl hung up. With a heavy heart, I started mentally rehearsing what I would say to Evelyn.

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: Karl hung up. With a heavy heart, I started mentally rehearsing what I would say to Monica.

174.speaker: Player
174.text: "Oh, no. I was afraid of that."

176.speaker: Karl Greiser
176.text: "He wished it to be read by Evelyn alone, sir."

178.speaker: Karl Greiser
178.text: "Would you like to break the news to Mrs. Vectern or should I?"

179.speaker: Player
179.text: "I'll tell Evelyn. Thanks again for your help."

180.speaker: Player
180.text: "Can you call Evelyn and tell her? I'm not sure I'm up to the task."

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: Karl hung up. With a heavy heart, I started thinking about what I would say to Monica.

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: Karl hung up. With a heavy heart, I started thinking about what I would say to Evelyn.

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: I went to my private study, picked up the phone and called Lucian.

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: The phone rang for only a few seconds.

197.speaker: Lucian Galade
197.text: “Not a problem, sir. I sleep next to the phone in case I'm ever needed.”

200.speaker: Lucian Galade
200.text: "We still have Petr's wedding ring and a sample of his handwriting. It would be fairly easy for the SSP to plant evidence of his death by suicide."

202.speaker: Player
202.text: "What are you waiting for? Get on it!"

205.speaker: Player
205.text: "I told Evelyn not to investigate, but I don't know how much longer I can hold her off."

208.speaker: Lucian Galade
208.text: "The last I knew of it, Mr. Vectern had been well and properly disposed of."

209.speaker: Player
209.text: "Not well enough. Evelyn's going to investigate this."

210.speaker: Lucian Galade
210.text: "Frankly, sir, that would only lead to more unnecessary suspicions. And as someone who had to spend a good stretch of his career putting up with Mr. Vectern, I do feel a certain kinship with Evelyn."

211.speaker: Lucian Galade
211.text: "I hope you're not suggesting the SSP dispose of her as well."

212.speaker: Player
212.text: “Remember that thing with Petr? Turns out Karl didn't cover his tracks.”

213.speaker: Player
213.text: “Remember that thing with Petr? Turns out you didn't cover your tracks.”

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: He hung up. I put away the phone and went down to the bedroom to get some sleep.

218.speaker: Player
218.text: "I'll tell Evelyn the news. Thanks again for your help and discretion."

219.speaker: Player
219.text: "He was a prick who didn't deserve you."

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: Evelyn hung up. With a heavy heart, I started thinking about what I would say to Monica.

226.speaker: Player
226.text: "Can you call Evelyn and tell her? I'm not sure I'm up to the task."

229.speaker: Lucian Galade
229.text: "The SSP has complied with our request, sir."

230.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
230.text: "Maybe not. But he didn't deserve to go out like this."

234.speaker: Lucian Galade
234.text: "They kept it vague. Asking forgiveness from you and Evelyn, that sort of thing."

235.speaker: Player
235.text: "Oh, no. I was afraid of that."

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: Lucian hung up. With a heavy heart, I started mentally rehearsing what I would say to Monica.

241.speaker: Lucian Galade
241.text: "His wedding ring, a half-empty bottle of pills, and a handwritten note were planted on a bridge overlooking the Unger River."

242.speaker: Lucian Galade
242.text: "The man was obviously in an unstable state before. I don't think it's a stretch of the imagination."

243.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
243.text: "A friend of mine in Erlory convinced local police to scour the area. They found Petr's wedding ring along with a half-empty bottle of pills and a handwritten note on a bridge overlooking the Unger River."

244.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
244.text: "He wanted it to be for my eyes only."

247.speaker: Lucian Galade
247.text: "I hope we never have to speak of this again, sir."

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: Lucian hung up. With a heavy heart, I started mentally rehearsing what I would say to Evelyn.

249.speaker: Player
249.text: "Do you think Evelyn will be convinced?"

254.speaker: Narrator
254.text: I picked up. It was Lucian.

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: I picked up. It was Evelyn.

263.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
263.text: "I need a moment. I'll talk to you soon."

279.speaker: Player
279.text: "I'm sorry about what happened between you two."

286.speaker: Karl Greiser
286.text: "This isn't easy for me to say."

289.speaker: Player
289.text: "Please tell me you have good news."

291.speaker: Karl Greiser
291.text: "I was contacted last night by Holsord Post journalists asking about the whereabouts of Mr. Vectern. Apparently his ex-wife had been worrying."

292.speaker: Karl Greiser
292.text: "You may want to sit down, sir."

293.speaker: Karl Greiser
293.text: "I sent some of my men to investigate, and, well..."
